chemicalStructureChecks: Ethanol methyl carbon has three C-H bonds and one C-C bond. OH-bearing carbon now has C-C, C-O and two C-H bonds.
Ethanal carbonyl carbon has C-C, C=O and C-H.
Carboxylic acid carbon has C-C, C=O and C-OH.
Secondary alcohol has two methyl groups, H and OH; ketone retains two methyls and carbonyl.
Tertiary alcohol has three methyl groups and OH. No carbonyl product claimed without C-C cleavage.
